parsed.note_claim: A Russian drone hit the locomotive of a regular Kyiv–Warsaw train ~2 km inside Ukraine with no injuries, while Johnson, Sautter and other officials were on a separate chartered train that was stopped and partly evacuated.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: eine Drohne die Lokomotive eines Personenzugs zwei Kilometer vor der polnischen Grenze angegriffen, wie die ukrainische Staatsbahn Ukrsalisnyzja mitteilt. Verletzte gebe es nicht. [...] Sautter, reiste demnach in der Nacht mit einem privat gecharterten Zug von Kiew nach Polen. Am frühen Morgen sei der Zug dann nahe der polnischen Grenze gestoppt, wegen Drohnen seien Teile des Zuges evakuiert worden.
parsed.reason: The page confirms both that a drone struck the locomotive of a regular passenger train ~2 km from the border with no injuries, and that Sautter and other officials including Johnson were on a separately chartered train that was stopped and partly evacuated.
